comments: Registered as one bank on the chest base: the open frame is the tallest (the raised lid), and it sets the shared scale so that no lid is clipped, so the closed and hidden bodies are smaller than the 16x12 block.
The source pivot x is the centre of the base in each crop.
geometry: Collision is one tile and belongs to the rules; art never sets a hitbox. The stage stamps the frame bottom-centre at the tile centre x and one half tile below the tile centre y (the tile foot).
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Three separate drawings in the request order: closed, open with gold, hidden ghost.

pieces.label: closed-0: warm oak chest, iron bands, brass corners, aqua crescent plate.
pieces.name: closed-0

pieces.label: open-0: the same chest with the lid raised and a pile of gold.
pieces.name: open-0

pieces.label: hidden-0: the same chest in slate-indigo with a blank dark plate (the ghost).
pieces.name: hidden-0

size_basis: native canvas 16x12, anchor bottom-centre (8,12); stage 384x224 at 16 px per tile; a knight is 16x16; a chest is under a knight tall.
timing: closed, open and hidden 12 ticks each (30 Hz). Art never sets a hitbox (collision is one tile).
